lines.text: Jesus asks His disciples who people say He is, and they name John the Baptist, Elijah, and the prophets.
Peter answers that Jesus is the Christ, and Jesus warns them not to tell anyone about Him.
Jesus teaches that the Son of Man must suffer, be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed.
Peter takes Jesus aside to rebuke Him, and Jesus rebukes Peter, saying he has in mind the things of the Law.
Jesus calls the crowd and says whoever wants to save his life will keep it.
